title: Revolutionizing healthcare: Navigating the opportunities and challenges of AI integration
summary: Governments around the globe are issuing rules and frameworks for responsible artificial intelligence (AI) development and deployment. In the U.S., the landmark Executive Order on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence underscores the imperative to ensure the safety and security of AI systems, emphasizing the importance of building trust in these technologies. In the EU, the AI Act will be the first comprehensive AI law.
